edges.notes: tryGetInfo(url) -> postJson(url, get_info JSON-RPC body) -> fetch(url, { method: 'POST' }); url = getDaemonUrl() (config.ts): the Monero daemon at MONERO_DAEMON_ADDRESS ?? node-address.txt ?? '127.0.0.1:18081' (monerod, not in the repo; no repo server listens on 18081), or any node the user sets. External, null
tryGetHeight(url) -> fetch(`${url}/get_height`); url = getDaemonUrl(), the Monero daemon (default 127.0.0.1:18081, not in the repo). External, null
fetchQuote(): fetch(info.url), the current price source's URL: Kraken's or CoinGecko's public API, or PRICE_API_URL (custom, no value in the repo). External hosts, null
estimatedFeeAtomic(): fetch(`${status.url}/json_rpc`), status.url = the daemon's getDaemonUrl() (default 127.0.0.1:18081, monerod, not in the repo). External, null

api.health(): request('/api/health') -> fetch(path) (default GET). Root-relative; Vite proxies /api to http://127.0.0.1:(MONERO_BACKEND_PORT || 18082) = backend PORT || 18082 (config.ts), and in production the backend serves frontend/dist on the same origin. app.get('/api/health')
api.wallets(): request('/api/wallets'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/wallets')
api.walletInfo(): request('/api/wallet/info'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/wallet/info')
api.balance(): request('/api/wallet/balance'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/wallet/balance')
api.address(): request('/api/wallet/address'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/wallet/address')
api.transactions(limit): request(`/api/wallet/transactions?limit=${limit}`) (query dropped), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/wallet/transactions')
api.createWallet(): post('/api/wallet/create', body) -> request(path, { method: 'POST' }), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/create')
api.openWallet(): post('/api/wallet/open', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/open')
api.closeWallet(): post('/api/wallet/close', {}), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/close', closeHandler)
api.revealPhrase(): post('/api/wallet/phrase', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/phrase')
api.createSubaddress(): post('/api/wallet/subaddress', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/subaddress')
api.validateAddress(): post('/api/wallet/address/validate', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/address/validate')
api.refreshWallet(): post('/api/wallet/refresh', {}), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/refresh')
api.price(): request('/api/price'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/price')
api.support(): request('/api/support'), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.get('/api/support')
api.setPriceSource(): post('/api/price/source', body) (the call starts on the method's second line), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/price/source')
api.prepareSend(): post('/api/wallet/send/prepare', input) (the call starts on the method's second line), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/send/prepare')
api.send(): post('/api/wallet/send', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/send')
api.cancelSend(): post('/api/wallet/send/cancel', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/wallet/send/cancel')
api.setDaemon(): post('/api/node/daemon', body), same-origin /api (proxied to :18082). app.post('/api/node/daemon')
